# Darsi (درسي)

> Darsi is an offline-first learning web app (PWA) at https://darsiai.org that gives school and university teachers, and their students, practical training in artificial intelligence, programming, data, IoT and cyber security. Lessons are 10–12 minutes, with narrated videos, hands-on Labs, classroom projects and ready-to-teach slides and lesson plans, in English and Arabic (right-to-left), on any phone, even offline.

Darsi is a single-page app: every page below is rendered in the browser with JavaScript. Course, lab and progress screens open after signing in or after choosing "Continue without an account" on the home page. Staff screens (/admin, /teach, /super, /org, /results) and the API (/api/) are private and are not meant for crawling or automation.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://darsiai.org/): what Darsi is, how it works, the tracks, offers for organizations, standards and FAQ (English and Arabic)
- [How Darsi works](https://darsiai.org/#how): learn, practise, apply in a real classroom, teach with downloadable kits, prove it with certificates
- [Tracks](https://darsiai.org/#tracks): nine tracks with four levels each (Beginner, Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced), for teachers and for students
- [For organizations](https://darsiai.org/#orgs): ministries, school networks, universities and NGOs register, add people in bulk and follow their progress
- [Standards](https://darsiai.org/#standards): alignment with the UNESCO AI competency frameworks for teachers and students (2024) and EU DigComp 2.2
- [FAQ](https://darsiai.org/#faq): devices, offline use, classroom use of the slides, privacy and languages

## Learning

- [Lessons](https://darsiai.org/learn): the learner's home with courses for their tracks (after sign-in or guest mode)
- [Labs](https://darsiai.org/labs): more than 100 interactive practice apps, for example training a neural network, wiring a sensor, cracking a cipher or planning a delivery route
- [My tracks](https://darsiai.org/tracks): choose which tracks to follow and check your level

## Accounts

- [Create an account](https://darsiai.org/signup)
- [Sign in](https://darsiai.org/signin)

## Tracks

- Artificial intelligence: how models learn and why they fail, prompting for teaching, bias, privacy and academic honesty
- Internet of Things: sensors, data and low-cost builds, securing connected devices
- Cyber security: passwords, two-step verification, phishing, protecting school data, incident plans
- Programming: from blocks to Python that runs on the phone, reading, testing and fixing code
- Data engineering: collecting and cleaning school data, tables, SQL and pipelines
- Data science: honest charts, statistics and simple models
- AI agents: planning, tools and memory, keeping a person in charge, testing agents
- AI security: prompt injection, data leaks, poisoned data, safe AI rules for a school
- Optimization: timetables, routes and fair duties, from trial and error to solvers

## Optional

- [Open-source licences](https://darsiai.org/licences): third-party software used by Darsi
- [Web app manifest](https://darsiai.org/manifest.webmanifest): name, icons and install details of the PWA
- [Agentic Resource Discovery manifest](https://darsiai.org/.well-known/ard.json): machine-readable catalog of Darsi's resources for AI agents
